services.desc: Enjoy the boating lifestyle without owning a boat! Suntex Boat Club Memberships include unlimited access to an entire fleet of boats, depending on your membership level. We take care of everything from cleaning to maintenance so you can spend more time on the water having fun in one of our top-of-the-line watercraft! Directions Allatoona Landing Marina & Resort 24 Allatoona Landing Rd SE Cartersville, GA
